name: hxn-gpu-webgl2
description: WebGL2 for Haxe in the browser, on hxcpp and Ash compiled to wasm: buffers, textures, samplers, programs, vertex arrays and framebuffers
releasenote: Context.claimCanvas and Context.present: under Ash the context draws on a canvas of its own and shows its frames on the web page's once claimed, so the page can carry other browser agents, such as WebGPU's.
